# docs.langchain.com documentation — Langsmith — Javascript

> 20 page(s) of docs.langchain.com documentation — Langsmith under Javascript. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Javascript

- [Define a Managed Deep Agent](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-agent-definition.md): The agent definition selects the model and core capabilities of a Managed Deep Agent.
- [Connect a Managed Deep Agent to Slack](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-channels-slack.md): A Slack channel lets people invoke a managed deep agent through app mentions, direct messages, and replies in an active Slack thread.
- [Connect Managed Deep Agents to channels](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-channels.md): A channel makes a managed deep agent available in an external messaging service.
- [Managed Deep Agents CLI reference](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-cli.md): The `mda` CLI compiles and deploys code-first [Managed Deep Agents](/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-overview).
- [Deploy a Managed Deep Agent](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-deploy.md): Deploying a Managed Deep Agent compiles a code-first project into a managed LangGraph app, syncs deploy-owned context to [Context Hub](/langsmith/use-the-context-hub), uploads the…
- [Evaluate Managed Deep Agents](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-evals.md): Managed Deep Agents evals are [Harbor](https://www.harborframework.com/docs/tasks) tasks.
- [Add identity to Managed Deep Agents](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-identity.md): Identity controls who can call your Managed Deep Agents deployment. By default, identity is secure: `mda init` configures authentication with a LangSmith API key.
- [Add instructions to Managed Deep Agents](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-instructions.md): Instructions define the agent's behavior. They make up the core of the agent's system prompt.
- [Develop locally with LangSmith Studio](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-local-development.md): `mda dev` compiles a Managed Deep Agents project and runs it on a local Agent Server.
- [Connect to MCP servers](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-mcp-connectors.md): An MCP connector adds tools from remote [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](/oss/javascript/deepagents/mcp) servers to a managed deep agent.
- [Add memory to Managed Deep Agents](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-memory.md): Normally, a managed deep agent's conversational memory is scoped to a thread or session.
- [Add custom middleware to Managed Deep Agents](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-middleware.md): Managed Deep Agents support the Deep Agents `middleware` configuration surface.
- [Managed Deep Agents](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-overview.md): Managed Deep Agents (MDA) is the simplest way to build and deploy production agents. You focus on what your agent does.
- [Managed Deep Agents project structure](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-project-structure.md): A Managed Deep Agents project has a required agent entry and optional files that enable managed capabilities.
- [Managed Deep Agents quickstart](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-quickstart.md): Create and deploy your first Managed Deep Agent: scaffold a project, configure the model and instructions, add search, test in [LangSmith Studio](/langsmith/studio), and deploy…
- [Add a sandbox to Managed Deep Agents](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-sandboxes.md): Agents often want to write or execute code when doing their job.
- [Add schedules to Managed Deep Agents](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-schedules.md): Managed Deep Agents can run agents on a cron schedule. When you deploy the project, `mda deploy` provisions each schedule as a LangSmith cron after the deployment is live.
- [Add skills to Managed Deep Agents](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-skills.md): Skills package task-specific procedures and context into reusable directories. You can define them in markdown files, and they are picked up automatically by the agent.
- [Add custom tools to Managed Deep Agents](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-tools.md): Tools add custom capabilities to your agent.
- [Add a custom search tool, memory, and a schedule](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-tutorial.md): This tutorial continues from the [quickstart](/langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-quickstart).
